liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Saint Stephen** (1 review, 2 other sources): Reviewer describes a funky, in-the-pocket, danceable groove; The recording includes a Saint Stephen jam; the New Riders set may be missing up to three songs [1][2][15]
- **Friend Of//The Devil** (2 other sources): A splice exists here: the first four lines and a little preceding music are missing [1][2]
- **Not Fade//Away** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer calls the Not Fade Away, Goin' Down The Road, Not Fade Away sequence very hot; A reel flip occurs 17 seconds into Not Fade Away; the uploader tried to fix the levels [6][15]
- **Dancing In The Street** (1 review): Reviewer hears an extended opener with prominent keyboards and a free-form jam around seven minutes in, hinting at later Eyes [20]
- **Attics Of My Life** (1 review): Reviewer praises it as a strong reading of a song the band played live only rarely [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **If You Hear Me When I'm Leavin'**: rare: 3 archived performances [21]
- **Dirty Business**: rare: 12 archived performances [21]
- **Cecilia**: rare: 8 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-10-24.144903.sbd.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 144 min [1]
- **gd1970-10-24.141429.sbd.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac2496**: soundboard; 21 songs; 144 min [2]
- **gd1970-10-24.sbd.bihlmayer.pitch.31948.sbefail.flac16**: soundboard; 15 songs; 101 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the mix poor, with vocals high, so raising the volume to hear the instruments is risky; Reviewer finds instruments clearer than on the alternate copy, though the frequency range is limited, like a hallway speaker [15][20]
- **gd70-10-24.sbd.hollister.103.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 15 songs; 103 min; rated 3.3/5 by 10 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard mix is badly unbalanced and the band sounds lifeless, as if going through the motions; Reviewer finds the soundboard quality dreadful, even allowing for its age; Reviewer says the recording sounds muffled, as if heard through a wall, making the band's engagement hard to judge [9][11][13][14]
- **gd1970-10-24.179803.sbd.cassidy.minches.miller.v2.flac1648**: soundboard; 13 songs; 105 min [6]

## Around the show

- Phil told the crowd the band was exhausted from a long tour and would skip an encore; a front-row heckler reportedly flipped him off [10]
- Reviewer thinks the show is weak next to other shows of the period, suited only to completists [11]
- Reviewer sees the show as part of the band's late-1970 transition, with older pieces like Dark Star fading from sets [16]
- Not Fade Away, Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad and Truckin' were replacing the older material in sets [16]
- Reviewer notes Skull & Roses side four lists Not Fade Away and Goin' Down The Road as one track, breaking continuity [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-10-24.144903.sbd.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Will Boswell; transferred by Matt Smith and Sirmick; source: Unknown mono soundboard (low gen) - provided by Will Boswell [1]. Also: This copy derives from the same original source as the other circulating soundboards, with the same cuts [1]
- **gd1970-10-24.141429.sbd.boswell.smith.sirmick.flac2496**: taped by Will Boswell; transferred by SIRMick and Matt Smith; source: Source: Unknown mono soundboard (low gen) - provided by Will Boswell; [2]. Also: This copy derives from the same original source as the other circulating soundboards, with the same cuts [2]
- **gd1970-10-24.sbd.bihlmayer.pitch.31948.sbefail.flac16**: transferred by pitch correction using SoundEdit 16 on the Macintosh platform by Bob Bihlmayer; source: SBDMR->R->R->DAT->DAT->ZA2->DartPro32 [3]
- **gd70-10-24.sbd.hollister.103.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Six extra tracks after Lovelight, Dire Wolf through Sugar Magnolia, come from 12-31-70; Dire Wolf through Black Peter are from a stereo board [14]
- **gd1970-10-24.179803.sbd.cassidy.minches.miller.v2.flac1648**: taped by All Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 18, 2026; source: SBD > Master Reel (mono) > WAV (24-bit/96k) [6]. Also: Hi-res transfer of the master reel, supplied by Martin Cassidy, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1970-10-24 Sat Kiel Opera House, St. Louis, MO](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1419868436893/grateful-dead-1970-10-24-sat-kiel-opera) [22]
